policy: Validation reuses the reproduction matrix from Stage 5 because Stage 8 issued no source code changes. Determinism is verified by the matrix itself.
rationale: The Stage 7 directive requires a regression test that fails before a fix and passes after. The Stage 8 directive requires a minimal fix only after the regression test reproduces the root cause. Phase 8A's Stage 6 root-cause analysis concluded that the failure is NOT_REPRODUCED in Phase 8A's controlled conditions. Therefore Stages 7 and 8 do not produce a test-and-fix pair. Stage 9 validation is therefore a re-run of the reproduction matrix to confirm determinism, not a fix-validation sequence.
